style: Silent, warm, friendly product demo on a soft light background. Keep one consistent generic rounded chat-bubble silhouette as the sole dominant motif; show one bubble at a time, with the supplied otter sticker as its reply. Use only restrained lavender sampled from the sticker artwork. Keep Japanese copy large and high-contrast for in-feed reading. No phone frame, avatar, status bar, controls, LINE branding or other reconstructed app UI. No narration, music, price, sales or engagement claims.

customize.bubble: Use the catalog chat-message component as one neutral, generic message bubble with a small tail. Preserve the same scale, position and styling through the three message scenes; never show multiple bubbles at once. Keep its brief corner-grown entrance restrained, then hold. Do not add typing indicators, cursors, notification chrome or extra bounce effects.
customize.text: Use embedded Noto Sans JP for every Japanese line; do not use Inter or rely on a system-only CJK fallback. Keep copy within generous safe margins and make it legible at in-feed size.
customize.palette: Sample a restrained lavender accent from the artwork's chest star; keep the character's original peach and salmon colors intact over a warm near-white field.
customize.layout: Place the bubble in the upper-middle with the sticker below or beside it, clear of text. Keep the same silhouette and alignment in both use cases. On the final card, resolve that silhouette around the title and CTA.

supporting_components.use: Use its calm closing layout for the exact title and CTA only. Omit logos, URLs, badges, proof, or extra claims; keep the bubble as the dominant shape.

media_assets.playback: Timeline-controlled PNG frames at source cadence, one play, no loop. Hold each source frame for 3 composition frames at 30fps.
